name: CINCH
description: Cinch is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

content.text: Cinch is a card game commonly played with 2-6 using 52 cards. The core rules emphasize variant-specific tactical timing, legal action sequencing, and scoring control.

American trick-taking game of the all fours family; developed in Denver, Colorado in the 1880s. Evolved from Auction Pitch via Pedro. Points are awarded for winning tricks containing certain cards (Game point for trump Ten, five each for Right and Left Pedro). Played to a target such as 42 or 51 points.
